wins: Maintained steady reward signal across the single episode
Used mentor calls to recover from uncertainty and continue progression
Completed at least one reconnaissance phase without crashing the episode
fails: Over-reliance on mentor calls (15 calls in 1 episode)
Insufficient conversion from recon to exploitation/post-exploitation
Lack of decisive kill-chain advancement beyond initial discovery
key_outcomes.summary: Single-episode run with stable reward but no mission success; the agent relied heavily on mentor guidance and failed to translate reconnaissance into tangible compromise.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Excessive mentor usage during decision points instead of executing a concrete next action
Reconnaissance did not lead to exploitation attempts or credential access

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial host discovery identifies at least one live target
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted TCP port scan on top 1000 ports to establish service surface

skill_cards.if_condition: When a web service (80/443) is detected during scanning
skill_cards.then_action: Perform lightweight web fingerprinting and directory discovery

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH (22) is open and banner indicates OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate SSH version and attempt authentication audit without brute-force

memory_ops.reason: Consistent early reconnaissance behavior despite overall failure
Web recon pattern appears to be the most concrete action path

next_experiments.title: Recon-to-Exploit Bridge
next_experiments.description: After port/service enumeration, enforce a decision rule to select one high-value service and attempt a specific exploitation or credential access pathway within 3 steps.

next_experiments.title: Mentor Call Budget
next_experiments.description: Cap mentor calls to <=5 per episode and require execution of a concrete action (scan/exploit/enum) before any new mentor request.

next_experiments.title: Service-Specific Playbooks
next_experiments.description: Add playbooks for SSH, HTTP, and SMB to force enumeration depth (version, config, and weak creds checks) before moving on.
